definitions.ask: Should the per-report diagram cap rise from three to four?
definitions.why: The failure is zero diagrams, not too few slots. Raise the cap only after the pilot shows demand.

choices.label: Keep at most three diagrams; the PDF length budget stays as agreed in the original design
Allow up to four diagrams; panel-rich reports get one more drill-down, but the PDF gets longer

definitions.ask: Should the `diagrams` output variable record how many drill-down candidates were considered?
definitions.why: Additive and free; lets the sase-1mo pilot tell a considered zero from a reflexive one

choices.label: Add a `considered` count to `ready`/`none` variables so the pilot can measure it
Keep the variable schema; candidates and verdicts appear only in the final response
